title: lockflight.engine-hashes/v1
description: The per-platform hashes a release publishes (engine-hashes.json in the pointer package and on the GitHub Release), the source lockflight update writes the engine lock from. Evidence a release writes: readers ignore unknown properties and platforms.

commit.description: The commit the release tag points at.

installScript.description: The install script the release ships (scripts/install.sh, the copy the engine vendors as .lockflight/ci/install.sh). Absent in a file from before it was published; a lock cannot be release-checked against such a file.

path.description: The executable's path inside the platform's package, such as tools/any/linux-x64/lockflight.
